dataFlow.reason: Presentational mention field; the structured value arrives via props and updates flow out through onChange.

guards: browser-only measurement, focus, selection, and observer work runs in event handlers or $effect

verification.purpose: Per-component port gates (files, no-style, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest)

gaps: Phase 1 still-port: the autosize height, anchor measurement, trigger suggestion panel, list highlight, token transition, and count/direction motion render static end-states. Anchor and panel measurement are live DOM measurements; only animated transitions are deferred.
React render-time state synchronization maps to `$effect` synchronization; `ResizeObserver` and `requestAnimationFrame` run client-only.
The imperative handle (`focus`, `insert`, `openSuggestions`, `clear`, `textarea`) is exposed through a bindable `ref`, rather than React `useImperativeHandle`.
